findings.current: “Mmph, mmph. Ah hih he ho. Ha hu i heup hi ha.”
findings.defect: The opening “Mmph, mmph” duplicates an eating sound already rendered as “Nom, nom” in the preceding dialogue and is absent from this source utterance.
findings.rationale: The Korean has 우걱, 우걱 as its own preceding utterance, followed separately by 아히헤호. 하후이흡히하. The assembled English adds a second rendering of the first sound to the latter line.
findings.replacement: “Ah hih he ho. Ha hu i heup hi ha.”

findings.current: Hyuk Mujin whispered with a thoroughly disgusted expression.
findings.defect: The translation changes Mujin’s specific loss of appetite into general disgust.
findings.rationale: 입맛이 뚝 떨어진 얼굴 specifically describes someone whose appetite has abruptly vanished, which is contextually tied to watching Cheongpung eat.
findings.replacement: Hyuk Mujin whispered, looking as though he had completely lost his appetite.

summary: The chapter is broadly faithful, with two minor defects involving an added eating sound and a source-specific reaction.
